Title: Azure Stream Analytics—C# custom deserializers in Cloud and IoT edge

Body.Content:
Take advantage of the power of Stream Analytics to process data in Protobuf, XML, or any custom format. It’s also now possible to implement custom deserializers in C#, which can then be used to deserialize events received by Azure Stream Analytics.

Learn more.
